reason: app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:138 takes the host from `URI(website.to_s).host`, which in Ruby keeps the original case. Lines 141, 146 and 149 then compare it with `Discourse.current_hostname` using case-sensitive `==` and `ends_with?`, and the stored website is never lowercased (`app/models/user_profile.rb` has no normalization). So `http://Example.com/u` does not match `example.com`.
